mission: Implement append-only lease/heartbeat/stale-probe/recovery-attempt semantics for the universal worker canary, with safe stale suspicion, recovery eligibility, immutable original evidence, CAS-aware recovery modes, and late-return preservation.
useful_delta: Implemented a dependency-free lease/recovery decision library plus a read-only stale scanner CLI and an 11-case falsification suite. The implementation encodes the binding 20/30-minute canary thresholds, refuses age-only stale inference when policy is absent, suppresses retry after durable RETURN/DONE, requires refetch/CAS and overlap checks, emits only append-only recovery claim/run candidates with original lineage preserved, and requires explicit validation when a late original RETURN races a recovery attempt.

artifacts.role: Pure recovery state/CAS/receipt builders and late-return reconciliation primitive
Read-only JSON CLI/projection that emits stale-probe and optional recovery candidates without mutating source truth

coverage: >=30m RECOVERY_ELIGIBLE only with all safety gates
new heartbeat invalidates prior stale assumption
missing binding policy => HOLD, never inferred stale
append-only recovery claim + fresh run lineage
late original return => preserve both + validation required

source_freshness.concurrency_note: Main and published runtime advanced during this run due parallel workers. Exact target files were absent at prewrite; own claim remained exclusive; subsequent observed concurrent changes were outside this run's three implementation paths and own evidence scope.

authority.preservation_rule: Original claims, attempts and returns are evidence; recovery artifacts are append-only and do not confer promotion authority.

known_limits: This canary implements the decision/scanner primitives; unattended periodic invocation still belongs to the external Metabolism Tick/event-loop deployment boundary.
The scanner emits recovery candidates but does not itself create GitHub recovery claims or mutate runs; a separately authorized executor must persist those append-only artifacts.
Recovery eligibility still depends on caller-supplied target-refetch and active-overlap evidence; uncertainty parks/reloads rather than guessing.
result_summary: COMPLETE: executable stale/recovery canary primitives are on main, validated 11/11, preserve original evidence, and do not self-promote authority.
